## Complete Project Catalog & Technical Case Studies

### 1. Blood Bank Management System (نظام إدارة بنك الدم)
- Summary: A comprehensive web application featuring robust Laravel backend routes, secure authentication, and data analysis components to coordinate blood donations efficiently.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Secure User Authentication: Role-based access control and encrypted user sessions.
  - Donation Coordination: Efficient matching and tracking modules for blood requests and donors.
  - Interactive Views: Integrated frontend views communicating seamlessly with backend controllers.
- Tech Stack: Laravel, MySQL, PHP, React Views, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
- Live Web Link: https://blood-bank-3hol.vercel.app/
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Baskootaa/BloodBank

### 2. Gym Membership Management System (نظام إدارة العضويات والجيم)
- Summary: Engineered backend tracking scripts (like expiring.php) utilizing advanced PDO joins to monitor subscription durations and manage member renewals automatically.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Expiry Tracking Automation: Custom background tracking script checking active memberships against current dates.
  - Advanced PDO Queries: Complex SQL table joins (`INNER JOIN`) linking members to their respective subscriptions and packages.
  - Administrative Dashboard: Full management control over member registrations, status updates, and renewals.
- Tech Stack: Custom PHP, PDO, MySQL, SQL Automation, Render, HTML5/CSS3.
- Live Web Link: https://gym-master-q1eu.onrender.com/
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Baskootaa

### 3. Personal Developer Workshop & Code Lab (ورشة مأزن البرمجية)
- Summary: An interactive code lab showcasing advanced backend problem-solving exercises, security implementations, and raw database queries.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Advanced Database Queries: Optimized SQL join exercises and relational schema management.
  - Auth & Hashing Lab: Secure credential hashing (`password_hash`, `password_verify`) and session control.
  - Custom Logic & Parsers: Algorithmic backend scripts and automated monitoring parsers.
- Tech Stack: PHP, SQL, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Baskootaa
